data.one_liner: Pure Dart implementation of secp256k1 ECDSA signing and verification
data.what_it_does: Provides key generation, ECDSA signing, and signature verification on the secp256k1 curve. It also exposes utilities for public key handling and curve point validation.
use_when: Generating Bitcoin or Ethereum private/public keys
Verifying ECDSA signatures in Dart applications
avoid_when: When deterministic ECDSA signatures are required
When using Schnorr signatures or other curve algorithms
strengths: Security fixes for key generation and nonce handling
Low‑S normalization and curve point validation
weaknesses: Does not provide deterministic ECDSA signatures
Limited to ECDSA, no Schnorr support
